The '''Archae Teuthis system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].

{{System-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
"''Architeuthis''" is the scientific name for the genus of the [[Wikipedia:Giant Squid|Giant Squid]].
